description:
At Paramount Remedies, we believe in the inherent power of nature to heal and nourish. As a leading herbal supplement company, we are dedicated to sourcing the highest quality botanicals and crafting exceptional remedies that support your holistic well-being.

Driven by a passion for natural wellness, our team of experts combines ancient wisdom with modern science to create innovative herbal formulations. We prioritize meticulous research and testing to ensure the potency, purity, and effectiveness of our products.

From traditional herbs to rare botanical treasures, we curate a diverse range of supplements that address various health needs. Our commitment to sustainability extends to every step of our production process, promoting ethical sourcing and eco-friendly practices.

Terms of Agreement:

1. Affiliate Application: By submitting an affiliate application to join the Paramount Remedies affiliate program, you agree to comply with all terms and conditions outlined below.

2. Enrollment: Upon approval, you will be granted access to the Paramount Remedies affiliate program. This partnership does not constitute an employment relationship or any exclusive arrangement.

3. Commissions: You will earn a commission for each qualified sale generated through your unique affiliate link. Commissions are based on the final purchase amount after discounts and excluding taxes, shipping, and returns.

4. Affiliate Links: You will be provided with unique affiliate tracking links and banners for promotional use. These links are essential for accurate commission tracking and reporting.

5. Promotion Guidelines: You are encouraged to promote Paramount Remedies in a positive and ethical manner. Use of false claims, misleading information, or spammy tactics is strictly prohibited. You may promote through websites, social media, email marketing, and other legitimate methods.

6. Prohibited Activities: Affiliates are prohibited from bidding on trademarked terms, impersonating Paramount Remedies, or engaging in any unethical activities. Violation of these terms will result in immediate termination from the affiliate program.

7. Cookie Duration: Cookies are set to a 30-day tracking period. If a customer makes a purchase within this period after clicking your affiliate link, you will receive the commission.

8. Payouts: Commissions will be paid on a regular monthly basis as outlined in the affiliate program documentation. Payouts are subject to a minimum threshold, as determined by Paramount Remedies.

9. Payment Method: Payments will be made through the chosen payment method during the application process. You are responsible for providing accurate payment information.

10. Tracking and Reporting: You will have access to a dashboard with real-time tracking and reporting of clicks, conversions, and commissions generated through your affiliate links.

11. Termination: Paramount Remedies reserves the right to terminate the affiliate partnership at any time if there is a violation of these terms or if the affiliate's actions are deemed harmful to the brand's reputation.

12. Modification of Terms: Paramount Remedies may modify these affiliate marketing terms at any time. Affiliates will be notified of any changes and are responsible for adhering to the updated terms.

13. Indemnification: Affiliates agree to indemnify and hold Paramount Remedies harmless from any claims, damages, or liabilities arising from their promotional activities.

14. Confidentiality: All proprietary and confidential information shared by Paramount Remedies is to be kept confidential and used solely for the purpose of promoting the affiliate program.

By participating in the Paramount Remedies affiliate program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these affiliate marketing terms. Effective cooperation and compliance with these terms will contribute to a successful and mutually beneficial partnership.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Paramount Remedies! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

 

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

 

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

 

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

 

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

 

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

 

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

 

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: paramountremedies123@gmail.com.

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to paramountremedies123@gmail.com for support.
